name: Bases Transpose Table
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Markdown export now escapes tag, math, comment and highlight marks.
A text cell with stored CR line breaks is no longer rewritten when it loses focus without a change.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Pro Markdown export now shows tag, math, comment and highlight marks as plain text.
A cell with Windows line breaks is left alone when you click away without editing.
tip: Select Edit row beside a property to set one value across two to five visible notes.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Bases Transpose Table is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with Bases. Bases is still new, and your setups teach me a lot.
